sentence_window_coscale.writer: last s(m) generic punctuation-boundary sentences of the input, document order; reads neither the question nor any task vocabulary

generic_bm25_coscale.writer: ascent/generic_retrieval.py: deterministic BM25-like lexical chain over generic sentences, s(m) passages, document order

bge_m3_coscale.writer: BGE-M3 dense + BM25 reciprocal-rank fusion with the official bge-reranker-v2-m3, three target-blind hops, first s(m) passages in document order

primary_analysis.estimand: Panel-clustered change in task-balanced ASCENT-minus-Foundation absolute gain between adjacent co-scaled endpoints on QA2+QA3.
primary_analysis.test: One-sided paired t-test over ten panel-level gain differences; report unadjusted two-sided 95% Student-t confidence intervals.
primary_analysis.multiplicity: Holm step-down family-wise correction at alpha 0.05 across the two directional adjacent contrasts.
primary_analysis.gate: Both adjacent mean increments must be positive and both Holm-adjusted one-sided p-values must be below 0.05. No endpoint, task, or panel may be removed.
primary_analysis.note: same estimands and Holm family as the canonical confirmation; computed per generic condition by experiments/analyze_generic_writer_ablation.py

secondary_analysis.canonical_vs_raw_3b: Paired panel-cluster canonical-minus-raw accuracy and gain at the 3B/3-slot endpoint, overall and by task.
secondary_analysis.remaining_error_elimination: Descriptive panel-cluster RWE at every endpoint and adjacent RWE increments; not a promotion gate because of the registered ceiling.
secondary_analysis.endpoint_accuracy: Foundation and ASCENT accuracy with panel-cluster 95% confidence intervals, overall and by task.
secondary_analysis.failure_accounting: Retain every regression and invalid output; report task and panel localization.

interpretation_rule_fixed_in_advance.co_scaling_survives: for a generic writer, the three endpoint gains increase strictly with reader scale AND both adjacent one-sided increments pass Holm at family-wise 0.05 (the registered rule of the canonical study)
interpretation_rule_fixed_in_advance.co_scaling_collapses: either condition above fails for that writer
interpretation_rule_fixed_in_advance.consequence_if_all_generic_writers_colla: the schema is doing the work; the manuscript narrows the claim to structured-fact-retrieval tasks (Option B) and reports these results in Appendix D
interpretation_rule_fixed_in_advance.consequence_if_any_generic_writer_surviv: the co-scaling pattern does not depend on the hand-built schema; reported as the direct answer to Reviewer 2 point 2 while still scoping the claim to the evaluated benchmarks (Option A)
interpretation_rule_fixed_in_advance.schema_advantage_estimand: canonical minus generic ASCENT accuracy per endpoint, paired over the ten panels, both measured on the same A100 instance (canonical from artifacts_revision/target_blindness_2026-09), so that no GPU-architecture difference enters the contrast
interpretation_rule_fixed_in_advance.foundation_invariance_check: Foundation predictions must be identical across the three generic conditions and the instrumented canonical run on the same instance (same prompts, same GPU); any difference is reported
